compile/1 function accepts YAWL specification map
Returns {ok, InitialMarking, Transitions} or {error, Reason}
Initial marking correctly identifies input conditions with start tokens
Transitions have correct preset/postset from flow definitions
Places created for all tasks and conditions
Integration with pnet_types:marking() for marking representation

user_stories.title: Implement bounded state space explorer
acceptance_criteria: Module yawl_explorer.erl created
explore/3 function accepts InitialMarking, Transitions, and Bounds
Performs depth-limited DFS with configurable depth bound (default 15)
Enforces token bound per place (default 10 tokens)
Tracks visited states using pnet_marking:hash/1 for cycle detection
Returns {ok, [Traces]} where each trace is a list of markings
Terminates within reasonable time for workflows up to 50 tasks
Handles dead states (no enabled transitions) correctly
user_stories.notes: Core exploration algorithm. Must use pnet_marking:hash/1 from /Users/sac/cre/src/pnet/pnet_marking.erl:320 for stable state hashing.

user_stories.title: Implement deadlock detection
acceptance_criteria: check_deadlock/1 function implemented in yawl_model_checker
Analyzes exploration traces to detect deadlock states
Deadlock = no enabled transitions but not in final marking
Returns validation_error with code deadlock_detected
Error message includes location information (marking snapshot)
Detects known deadlock case (XOR split with AND join mismatch)
No false positives on correct workflows
user_stories.notes: Key validation property. Must distinguish between deadlock and proper completion at output conditions.

user_stories.title: Implement dead transition detection
acceptance_criteria: check_dead_transitions/2 function implemented
Extracts fired transitions from exploration traces
Identifies transitions that never fired within depth bound
Returns validation_error with code dead_transition
Error severity is warning (not error)
Reports location (transition ID) for each dead transition
Detects isolated/unreachable tasks
user_stories.notes: Helps identify workflow design issues. Requires trace tracking to be enhanced in yawl_explorer to record which transitions fired.

user_stories.title: Implement completion option check
acceptance_criteria: check_completion/1 function implemented
Checks if any trace reaches final marking (tokens at output condition)
Returns validation_error with code no_completion_path
Detects workflows that cannot complete (e.g., infinite loops)
Error severity is error (blocking issue)
Correctly identifies final markings based on output conditions
user_stories.notes: Critical soundness property. Workflow must have option to complete to be valid.

user_stories.title: Enhance trace tracking for transition history
acceptance_criteria: yawl_explorer trace type modified to include transition IDs
trace_step() type defined as {TransitionId, Marking}
explore/3 returns traces with transition information
extract_fired_transitions/1 can identify all transitions in trace
Backward compatible with existing code
user_stories.notes: Required for dead transition detection. Must modify DFS to record which transition fired between states.
